top_concerns: Only 20-50 items per dataset and no confidence intervals; 77.6 vs 80.1 and the 4th-place ranking are within noise
Multilingual human baselines (Arabic/Russian/Norwegian wins) come from a single annotator; annotator identity is confounded with language/cultural claims
Human and model protocols are not truly aligned (probe-trained classification, clustering with unspecified k, binary-to-ranking reranking, 0-5 STS)
Claim that models exploit label patterns where humans disagree, and that datasets should be replaced, is asserted not tested (no contamination, error or noise analysis)
Aggregation and reporting inconsistencies (26 vs 14 pairs, unweighted mixed-metric averages, English-only models in multilingual comparisons)
